_doc: Licence + provenance for every model weight / data file the pipeline downloads (Roadmap v2 §11.2). setup_voters.py pins these revisions and writes MANIFEST.json (sha256 per file) in the voter dir. Checksums of large weights are recorded there at setup time, not here. Verified 2026-10-29.

wordlist.name: hi_IN.dic
wordlist.commercial_use: used as runtime lookup data only, downloaded at setup, not redistributed in the bundle

hinglish_romanizer.name: Yapper Transliterator (map_lipi)
hinglish_romanizer.licence: code Apache-2.0; yapper_map.json + Lipi weights 'license: other' (Dakshina, Xlit-Crowd, L3Cube, Aksharantar terms)
hinglish_romanizer.commercial_use: WARN: verify upstream data terms before publish; runtime only, not redistributed in the bundle

karaoke-subs.use: ASS karaoke generation via public API, unmodified (core/captions_adapter.py)

rejected_alternatives.AI-Builder-Club/skills karaoke-captions: no LICENSE file in repo -> reference only
rejected_alternatives.zeke/nice-ass-captions: no LICENSE file in repo -> reference only
rejected_alternatives.CosLynxAI/ffmpeg-word-captions: MIT but Node.js runtime; keep as fallback

depth_parallax.name: Depth Anything V2 Small (transformers)
depth_parallax.renderer_credit: warp approach (backward remap by depth influence, gradient-weighted depth feather, fold = sampling grid running backwards) studied from longweekendlabs/parallax-studio (MIT) @ 32e4cb451abf117a148594269219691f7144ce88; KANG code is own, no files copied

face_detection_crop_reuse.name: YuNet face detector (face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx)
face_detection_crop_reuse.used_by: core/crop_reuse.py (v14): crops touching a detected face are refused; OpenCV 5 has no CascadeClassifier, so YuNet replaces Haar

ai_motion_i2v.name: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B (diffusers)
licence_evidence: https://huggingface.co/Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers (model card front matter license: apache-2.0, HF API cardData.license = apache-2.0)
ai_motion_i2v.commercial_use: yes (Apache-2.0); outputs labelled 'AI animated', credited as modified (AI motion)
ai_motion_i2v.used_by: tools/kaggle_ai_motion (Kaggle T4 GPU) -> core/ai_motion.py masked composite

alternatives_ok.Wan2.1-Fun-1.3B-InP / V1.1: hf:alibaba-pai/Wan2.1-Fun-V1.1-1.3B-InP, Apache-2.0 (HF API), 1.3B fits T4 easily but 480P and needs the VideoX-Fun code (non-diffusers weights) -> fallback only, not used
alternatives_ok.Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P: hf:Wan-AI/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P-Diffusers, Apache-2.0, 14B (~28 GB fp16) does not fit a 16 GB T4 without heavy offload/quantisation -> not used

LTX-Video (Lightricks).evidence: https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-Video (license: other; files ltx-video-2b-v0.9.license.txt = RAIL-M with use restrictions, LTX-Video-Open-Weights-License-0.X.txt = commercial entities >= $10M revenue need a paid licence)

CogVideoX-5B-I2V.evidence: https://huggingface.co/zai-org/CogVideoX-5b-I2V/blob/main/LICENSE (The CogVideoX License: commercial use needs registration, 1M visits/month cap)

Stable Video Diffusion img2vid-xt.evidence: https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid-xt/blob/main/LICENSE.md (Stability AI Community License: revenue cap USD 1M, registration)
